notes.title: Demo Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi, I'm Daniel the dev behind Vangaro Tactics.
Here's a new patch for the demo.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]
- Enforce resolutions of 16:9 aspect ratio (from Options menu dropdown)
- Enforce 16:9 resolution after startup (in case wrong one is set from older build)
- Fixed "Reset Video Options" from Options menu
- Added Enter/Backspace to Accept/Cancel Button Prompts
- Fixed bug where ButtonPrompts would not display properly after changing from keyboard/mouse to controller
- Changed Level 1 dialog to display the game view as background. Also added numbers near the Factory and Barracks so it's easier to notice where to go first.
- Fixed bug where OverlayIcons would not be reused each level.

notes.title: Wargames Fest - Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello officers!
I'm Daniel, the dev behing Vangaro Tactics.

I'm here to announce there's a new Demo Update for Steam's Wargames Fest. 
✨It includes lots of fixes, QoL and new stuff that comes together on the [b]improved Level 5: "Vera's Tank Counterattack"[/b].

I was planning to publish it earlier this week but it started with a national power outage here in Spain and then it's been mostly animating the AA/Transport Trucks (the vehicle plus the passenger defending it). Just a few hours ago I've hit a roadblock exporting the build, some textures looked glitchy with every build new, but it's fixed now, just needed to tidy up some space for the game engine to do its job :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/5ec3bcb10f5a2ae31bddccf4651d4d6e2635e4df.png[/img]
[*] ⚔ Battle against Vera and her [b]"Glacial Shield"[/b] power.
[*] 🛩 Use the [b]Recon biplane to Spot[/b] enemy units with flares and get a damage boost.
[*] 🚛 Beware of the [b]Anti-Aircraft trucks[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/46dd433bad14009b3efddbea8b9c874852e9f0a6.png[/img]
🚚 Also new art and combat animations for the [b]Transport Truck[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/3d927abf01e1a133f35da02db0396fd91e53fc7e.png[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*]💂‍♂️ [b]Sniper Auto-path[/b]: Hover over an enemy in range and the computer will decide a good ranged position to attack from (can also move to your desired position manually).
[*] [b]Improved Shop UI[/b]: for each unit it now shows the ones it's Effective and Vulnerable against
[*] Improved the Options Menu.
[*] 🔊[b]Audio notification[/b] when [b]Commander Power[/b] is ready. If the power fills up at the end of the turn it will wait a bit until changing turn to make it easier to notice it.
[*] [b]Faster New Turn animation[/b] on Stealth Missions: when no outpost is alerted it plays the shortest animation, when there's patrol units it shows the enemy UI but minimal; when an outpost is alerted it will show the full animation (like in non-stealthy levels).
[*]📃 [b]Commander Power tooltip[/b]: When your power is ready a description shows up when hovering over the button on the turn menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/2d4b23603858b47253140fa359650427133dc63e.png[/img]

[h1]Healing units[/h1]
Buildings can Heal/Repair units
[list]
[*] Heal infantry in Factories.
[*] Repair ground vehicles in the Barracks.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/1a215d136d07dd58baed4a916eaa1605bda87954.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 🔧[b]Mechanic unit ready to Repair[/b] 🚛.
[*] Also adding the ability to [b]Join damaged units[/b]  💂‍♂️+💂‍♂️.
[*] When Healing/Repairing/Joining units a heart icon shows up when the unit reaches full HP.
[/list] 
[h2]Extra:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Snipers get extra range from mountains (also Mortar and ATSniper but not playable in the demo).
[*] Computer buys units and Repairs vehicles with its Mechanic.
[*] Computer captures buildings and mines resources.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixing:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed button-smashing/double click in the turnMenu and actionMenu.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the Power Bar animation to not play.
[*] Fixed bug where the HQ's keylock would't dissappear after defeating all units from that outpost (Stealth Missions).
[/list]

notes.title: Music, Demo Update and recap
notes.notes:
Hi, this is the dev Daniel reporting from HQ!

These past weeks there's been updates and news I've missed to announce here so I'll do a recap.
If you've tried the demo v0.2 then you've seen almost all of this.

Also today I've just published the demo update v0.2.1 that improves the enemy AI (nothing to do with generative AI, just the code that controls enemy behaviour).


[h1]New music[/h1]
I'm happy to announce I've been working with the talented developer/artist/musician ChardiTronic for the original soundtrack. He's the solo developer of the crazy game Kinnikuneko: SUPER MUSCLE CAT, it released earlier this year, check it out!
[previewyoutube=2uYNCNDaI-c;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332950/KinnikuNeko_SUPER_MUSCLE_CAT/?curator_clanid=4777282

Some of his music is already in the demo, you can listen to the new Main Theme in the menu and also Lance and Vera's songs (work in progress).

[h1]Commander Powers[/h1]
Each commander has their own Power, now each one has a custom name and I've also improved the animation when the name shows up. 

You can try Lance's "Frontal Assault" in the demo, it gives a Damage Boost to all infantry units! ⚔

I've also improved the visuals and sounds of this boost (custom sound, particles, glow effect) to make them stand out from the default units.
[previewyoutube=pOItv1B7B_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
In the v0.2.1 there's a tutorial to introduce the powers!

[h1]Featured at Ñ3 conference[/h1]
The 9th of June Vangaro Tactics was featured in the frst edition of Ñ3, a showcase of upcoming indie game trailers from Spain and other Spanish-speaking countries. 

While it didn't reach the English-speaking community, it did a great job reaching the intended audience thanks to some established Spanish streamers watching it live before the Xbox conference. 
Chek out the other great games in there!
[previewyoutube=TcRNPB01eMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Updates and Bug-Fixing[/h1]
[h2]The bug[/h2]
While I was working on improving the enemy AI I was finally able to reproduce a bug that had been bothering me for a long time. I fixed it in the v0.2 but it took a toll on the udpate, I wanted to add some stuff that's work in progress for now.

The bug was happening only when the enemy attacked first, then when you attacked it would cause an error and the combat wouldn't happen (combat animaition would display wrong units too). 
Turns out it tried to access your "defeated guys" during the combat animation and that was causing the problem. 
 
[h2]More responsive control[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/7cf772268584b95b231bf169b71ab5799e3e51f7.png[/img]
I forgot this, so I'm updating the post:

- There was some unintended delay after using a unit, it was waiting for the Command Power bar to fill up before letting you take control. Now it's unsynced and it feels much better.

- Also improved how the cursor works depending on if you're using controller/keyboard or mouse:
[olist]
[*] With controller or keyboard it returns the cursor to the last unit when cancelling an action. It also auto focuses one of your units at the start of each player turn.
[*] When using a mouse it always moves the cursor to the mouse position; Before it wasn't so exact when clicking menus (cancel, wait, etc.). Also doesn't auto focus on any unit at the start of your turn.
[/olist]

[h2]Enemy Behaviour Update[/h2]
In the v0.2.1 the enemy AI does a better job choosing where to move to attack your units. The best example is the sniper, now it tries to do ranged attacks if it's possible.  

[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2221530/extras/test-gif-units-alpha-616.png?t=1718412452[/img]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Tanks don't destroy Transport Trucks with a single attack anymore

[h2]New Library Capsule [/h2]
I'm trying to get the game out there submitting to every event I can. One of these required a vertical capsule and the older one wasn't the best so I've done a new one. 
Did you notice the change in your library?


That's all for today,
Thanks for your attention :)

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi officers!
This is Daniel, the dev behind Vangaro Tactics.
I'm happy to share the changes and fixes I've added in the Demo Update v0.1.2.

[h2]Animated Battle Report[/h2]
Added a proper [b]Win/Game Over[/b] screen with animations and sounds. 
It's intended to look like a "vintage document" put together after each battle. Came up with this paper document with some tape, where there's badges attached and then each commander has a custom stamp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/cc31dc7cd8cb963eba0d3f3482fc6a08e7207577.gif[/img]

[h2]Transport Trucks[/h2]
- Added a new level to introduce Mining and Transport Trucks in isolation. This is to ensure players understand those mechanics before moving forward with the Stealth Missions.

- When hovering over a Transport Truck the UI now displays the "Cargo" icon and doesn't preview the damage like it would with an enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/cf0e4e6da1f5e540510f88bc9e76b3ef425faf15.png[/img]

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
Fixed and issue that hopefully avoids many bugs:
The Action Menu (Attack, Wait, etc) wasn't synced properly so if the player clicked too fast it could "click" the button before it was ready. It would cause that when choosing to Attack or Transport it would end up waiting instead, losing that unit's turn.

[h2]Extra[/h2]
[list]
[*] New mouse icon
[*] Improved the writing and fixed some errors in the dialogs
[*] Added explosions and particle effects when Combat Animations are disabled (example in the gif above). By default it only shows the animations during the player turn, but can be changed in the Options Menu.
[*] Added a proper "Thanks for Playing" screen at the end of the demo
[/list]

Thanks for reading!
You can try the Demo if you haven't already; Please share your feedback (there's a form inside).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732645/4c4a1e25bde194b8ce2ab5c9d3c711407dd13e15.png[/img]
